instruction: Fix `strip_comments` so it keeps the code before a `#` comment (the current code keeps the comment text instead of the code).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/parselib.py b/parselib.py
--- a/parselib.py
+++ b/parselib.py
@@ -16,7 +16,7 @@
     """Remove `#` line comments from a text block."""
     out = []
     for line in text.splitlines():
-        out.append(line.split("#", 1)[-1].rstrip())
+        out.append(line.split("#", 1)[0].rstrip())
     return "\n".join(out)
